z: 溱 i-osteon, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at i-osteon, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 溱 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 溲 i-osteon, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:

practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 溴 i-osteon, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:

practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 溶 i-osteon, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:

practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 溷 i-osteon, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:

practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 溺 i-osteon, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 溽 i-osteon, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 溿 i-osteon, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 滁 i-osteon, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 滂 i-osteon, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

practice: If you have already burned someone you love, say so before the day ends, and then do one ordinary kindness with your hands.

z: 滃 i-osteon, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 滄 i-osteon, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 滇 i-osteon, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 滉 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

z: 滊 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 滊 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 滋 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滋 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 滌 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滌 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滎 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 滑 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

z: 滓 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滓 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 滔 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滔 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 滕 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滕 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 滙 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 滙 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 滝 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滝 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 滞 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滞 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 滫 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滫 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 滬 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 滬 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 滯 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滯 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 滲 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滲 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 滴 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 滴 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 滷 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 滷 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 滸 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滸 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 滹 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 滾 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 滾 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 滿 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 漁 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 漂 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 漂 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 漆 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 漉 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 漉 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 漊 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 漌 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 漌 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 漏 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 漐 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 漑 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 漓 ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. Look long enough at ithambo elivulekile, intamo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 漓 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

z: 熏 isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熏 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 熒 isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熒 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 熔 isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熔 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 熕 isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熕 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 熖 isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is isikhumba sezicubu, isinye, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熖 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 熙 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熙 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 熛 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 熟 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熟 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 熠 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熠 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 熢 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熢 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 熨 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熨 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 熬 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 熮 ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熮 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 熯 ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熯 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 熱 ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 熳 ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熳 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 熹 ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熹 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 熺 ngesibonakhulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of the one who left and the one who remained. What you are seeing is ngesibonakhulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 熺 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.
